observations.note: The 54 KB change.diff was read five times in large slices before any other file was opened, so about 142k tokens of context were in place before the first write; per-file diffs or a size hint would shorten this.
child.py and filing.py were each opened several times in short slices and the _holds/_read grep was repeated, where one read of the needed range would have done.

conformance.item: Procedure 1: read the criteria, then the change
Procedure 2: open each touched file and the code around it, searching names before reading ranges
Procedure 3: check each criterion against the change and its tests
Procedure 4 and form of the draft: numbered findings with file:line and mark in findings.md
What blocks: mark blocking only for a wrong result, failure, hang, data loss or break of earlier behaviour
Limits: run no command, use only the read, search, list and write tools
Limits: open no other run document and never open a findings document
What to end with: ARTIFACT findings line
